test_cases.tc_title: When requested by this DID, the HU shall report the Tuner status. (read $2841, Tuner status)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. The Sirius XM chipset is powered and responding
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Read the X65 signal quality diagnostics
   $ 22 28 41

test_cases.tc_title: When requested by this DID, the HU shall report the Tuner status. ($2841, NRC 13 incorrectMessageLengthOrInvalidFormat)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. The Sirius XM chipset is powered and responding
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Read the X65 signal quality diagnostics and record as Quality_initial
   $ 22 28 41
2. Send a read request for DID $2841 with the last byte omitted
   $ 22 28
3. Read the X65 signal quality diagnostics
   $ 22 28 41
test_cases.expected_result:
1. Quality_initial is recorded
2. The negative response 7F 22 13 (incorrectMessageLengthOrInvalidFormat) is received
3. The reported X65 signal quality diagnostics equals Quality_initial

test_cases.remarks: Harman Scope: Need Rework; NRC per ISO 14229-1 (037 unspecified)
